episodes.title: Our Story
episodes.description: Two people brought together by fate, who choose each other every single day. Watch our story unfold.

episodes.title: First Meeting
episodes.description: We had no idea everything would begin that day. It was simple, but we never forgot it.

episodes.title: First Date
episodes.description: I was nervous, and so was she. But that night became our favorite memory.

episodes.title: Our Adventures
episodes.description: Anywhere, as long as we're together. Every place brings a new story and a new laugh.

episodes.title: Simple Days
episodes.description: Good food, long talks, and quiet moments. This is where we learned that love lives in the little things.

episodes.title: Until the End
episodes.description: There are many more chapters to write. And together, we're ready for anything.
